summary: Audited all 50 diencephalon + ventricular records (diencephalon-thalamus 16, -hypothalamus 12, -epithalamus-subthalamus 14, telencephalon-ventricles 7, -ventricle-segments 1) against taxonomy.json (all 50 registry rows diffed field-by-field), levels.json (17 anchors), the 138-part anatomy-manifest bboxes, the 7 diencephalic syndrome cards, anatomyAssets/SceneLayers body ownership, plates.json tags and tracts.json. Wrote docs/audit/v15/diencephalon.findings.json (41 findings, all 12 required keys, verdicts/severities in enum) and docs/audit/v15/diencephalon.md. Counts: ok 11 / wrong 15 / suspect 15 / unverifiable-here 0; severity critical 1 / major 9 / minor 31; 23 records carry a non-ok finding, 30 distinct records cited. Headline defects: (1) CSF flow is inverted and routed through a blind temporal horn in vent-lateral-ventricle and 6 sibling records (critical, contradicts vent-third-ventricle/vent-interventricular-foramen); (2) ctx-internal-medullary-lamina is marked midline at x=0, i.e. inside the third ventricle, and draws a 9x11x11 au v1 ellipsoid there (wrong/major); (3) surf-optic-chiasm origin3d [0,29,10] disagrees with the committed chiasm mesh (y 10.4-18.6, z 14.3-23.5) and with the sibling ctx-optic-chiasm [0,23.5,23.5] by 14.6 au - a divergence PLAN.md 2.7/8.2 had already recorded; (4) nuc-pulvinar bloodSupply invents an MCA/angular supply to the thalamus; (5) lvl-thalamus-rostral (y=36) is named for the optic chiasm but contains none of the chiasm/SON/SCN records or meshes. Also verified and left alone: VPL lateral to VPM, pulvinar posterior+lateral, STN dorsal to the SN meshes, mammillary bodies posterior to the infundibulum, ctx-pineal's extent equal to its baked bbox, midline assignments that match their meshes, and the mammillothalamic/hypothalamospinal direction. Plan deviations recorded in the .md: C1's breakdown of the 30 origin3d-less records is wrong (all 12 nrv-* and 14 vasc-* do carry origin3d; the real 30 include vent-lateral-ventricle and vent-choroid-plexus-lateral), so C4's size3d scope was re-derived as 'no committed body'. No data file was edited (git status confirms only the two audit files are mine). Verified: npm run validate exits 0 (0 errors/0 warnings); the findings-shape evidence command exits 0 ('findings 41'); a scripted check proves every count in the .md table equals the counts computed from the .json. No gate that needs Chrome or a re-bake was run or claimed.
